summary: One line, a drop-down Terminal and Command…. Once the bar stands, Graphite's window has no foot: foot_fold_qt folds 1.0's typebar dock away and leads its doors to one new place each (FOOT_MOVED, old -> new): Line, Search and Web are the bar's line (B2's rows plus 'Search inside files for …' and 'Search the web for …'); the Terminal is drop_terminal_qt, its own X window dropping 200 ms from the top edge (full width, 40 %), 1.0's Terminal code with DOS words, Esc clears the line, the same key puts it away and the app that had the keys gets them back; Log is View ▸ Log (Alt+6) with its own Filter line; the five meters are one tray item whose rows open the same cards. Command… (Ctrl+.) above Properties in the Explorer's right-click (List rows, Icons tiles, the folder itself) shows what Open runs and the Graphite line it is, with Copy and Put it in the line (command_card_qt). graphite-do terminal (Win+`, Ctrl+Alt+T), kas (Win+K) and halt (Pause) work from any app without bringing Graphite forward. Without the bar the foot stays as in 1.0.

decisions: The foot folds only once the bar stands (the dedicated session, or GRAPHITE_BAR=1 on X): without the bar its jobs have no other home, so 1.0's foot stays (and every tier test offscreen sees 1.0's foot). GRAPHITE_FOOT=1 keeps it even with the bar.

1.0's objects stay for their callers (host.type_bar, host.console, the meters); their doors are rerouted on the instances (set_target, search, run_operation; console.open and focus_box; pulse.open_card) instead of editing typebar_qt: Alt+1/Alt+4/Ctrl+K/Alt+3 open the bar's line, Alt+5 and Ctrl+Alt+` drop the Terminal, Alt+6 opens the Log.

Line, Search, Web: the bar's line (B2). Added through line_finder.MORE only when folded: 'Search inside files for …' (1.0's Search page, results in the working area) and 'Search the web for …' (own browser; none for an address, which keeps B2's Open row).

Terminal: 1.0's Terminal, the same code (console_qt.Console's shell methods borrowed): the configured shell per line, stdin closed, cd kept, output as text, DOS words first. Its own frameless Tool window, stays on top, on every desktop (B3's mark_everywhere); 40 % of the screen (at least 160 px), full width; 200 ms OutCubic slide, at once under Reduce motion. Esc clears the line (cmd's Esc), never closes; the same key, 'Put away' or exit closes; Ctrl+C stops what runs; Up/Down history; Tab completes a name; Ctrl+L clears. The window that was active (_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW) gets the keys back. The key toggles: when it is down, the key puts it away.

Log: one menu home, View ▸ Log (the same QAction as the foot's Log word, Alt+6), moved out of Tools ▸ Commands ▸ Writing Line in both cases; folded, it opens the working area's Log with its own Filter line (Enter filters; Ctrl+Enter starts a capture in Network, log_qt's own confirm; Esc folds the Log away); a second Alt+6 folds it.

Meters: one item in the bar's tray (MetersTray registered for B1's 'tray' slot): three drawn bars (CPU, GPU, RAM; an empty box when no reading) and 'CPU n %' on the tall bar, the glyph alone at 1366 as B1's tray; its tip and name say all five; a press opens the five rows, each opening the same meter_cards card above the tray item (the words of each row open it too). Ctrl+Alt+Del (graphite-do tasks) and her act that opens a meter's card anchor there. Her column's equalizer (cores, KRN, RAM, SSD, NET, GPU) is her own activity display, beside the foot's meters already in 1.0; it is left as it is.
Status messages ('Saved as…') already showed in the working area's message row (console.hint, not in the foot's dock), so they stay there.

Command…: in the Explorer's right-click above Properties (a List row, an Icons tile, and the folder itself on the empty space) and Ctrl+.; a card (QDialog) shows 'What Open runs' (app_files.choose + apps_catalog.command: the very code Open runs; a bridge family names /appfile.open; none says why) and 'What it is' (@files:…); a folder: @files:… and cd. Each with Copy and Put it in the line (the bar's line with its rows; without the bar, the foot's line). Nothing runs from the card.

graphite-do: terminal (Mod4 grave, Control Mod1 t), kas (Mod4 k), halt (Pause); none brings Graphite forward; kas is her controller's toggle (B3); halt is her controller's pause_key (never RESUME; held says so in her words).
No Kernel operation added; registry unchanged.
findings_for_the_coordinator: T2: no truth the tiers test changes offscreen (the foot folds only where the bar stands). Under the dedicated session the foot's dock is hidden; a check that measures host.type_dock there would see it folded. K0's chrome tokens still count a foot (48/44 px) that is not drawn once folded.

The Terminal is not a pty (1.0's Terminal is not either): interactive programs (vim, top, sudo's password prompt, ssh) do not work there, and a GUI app started from it keeps it busy until it exits. A pty terminal is a slice of its own.

HALT does not stop the owner's own Terminal commands (they are not her work); Ctrl+C and Stop do. Whether 1.0's Master Stop ended the console's process was not checked; it does not reach the drop-down's.
Only real Fluxbox can confirm Win+` (Mod4 grave) and Pause being grabbed; with Fluxbox, Ctrl+Alt+T inside Graphite also goes through graphite-do (same effect).
The smoke drove the keys through the real tools/graphite-do and the window's door (GRAPHITE_DO_SOCKET short path), not through Fluxbox; the stand-in manager focuses what is mapped.
Frames' 'What Open runs' uses an invented desktop entry (Notes Pad, notespad, written in the smoke's throwaway home): this machine has no text app.
K0's head_menus.MOVED gained one row (Writing Line ▸ Log -> View ▸ Log); K0's test still holds.
Command… is not yet on Start's tiles (no right-click there; B2), the Files tree of the left pane, or board tiles.

release_note: One line. With the bar standing, Graphite's window has no foot any more: Line, Search and Web are the bar's line (it also offers Search inside files and Search the web); the Terminal drops from the top of the screen over any app on Win+` or Ctrl+Alt+T, DOS words included (Esc clears the line; the same key, or exit, puts it away and gives the keys back); the Log is under View (Alt+6) with its own filter; the meters are one item in the tray. Right-click a file or folder in Files: Command… (Ctrl+.) shows the exact line it is or runs, with Copy and Put it in the line. Win+K opens Kasandra's panel and Pause presses HALT from any app.
